AutoVPN подключается к публичным серверам из стороннего списка. Их операторы не проверяются. Поставщик подписки видит запросы на скачивание, а проверки серверов обращаются к публичным адресам. Приложение не обещает анонимность. Обычный HTTPS по-прежнему нужен.
Версия для разработки. Подключение компьютера через TUN, защита и установщик ещё не завершены.

Пока нет серверов, подтверждённых по двум HTTPS-адресам.

limits: SafeHandle.IsClosed and Dispose return are managed observations of the same wrappers; IsInvalid is independent, and no absence of other native file users is inferred.
Restart Manager reports a bounded later application/service snapshot without share flags. Empty, incomplete, unknown-identity or unavailable-input observations do not identify an external blocker.
Only the diagnostic helper owned by the test can be stopped. No RmShutdown/RmRestart is used and no foreign PID is acted on.
The two large development package binary archives were not downloaded; API metadata and full package-job verification logs were checked. This is not installer or Windows11 acceptance.
Service authorization uses real account tokens under impersonation. The separate node-runtime lab verifies an actual standard-user primary process token.
GitHub runner post-job orphan housekeeping is recorded separately from forcedJobTermination=false for the owned node-runtime Job Object.
Production SYSTEM core execution, selected-node service handoff, TUN, WFP, system DNS/IPv6 protection, recovery and the normal installer remain unaccepted.
